# Rossella Magnani, communication designer

Communication designer based in Milan, working on exhibitions, event identities and multisensory experiences designed for the widest possible audience. MSc Communication Design, Politecnico di Milano (2024 to present); BSc Communication Design, Politecnico di Torino (2021 to 2024).

Contact: magnanirossella02@gmail.com (mailto:magnanirossella02@gmail.com) · LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/in/rossella-magnani-276219279/) · About (/about) · CV, PDF (/Rossella_Magnani_CV.pdf)

## Experience

2026 · MSc thesis researcher and exhibition designer, Spazio Geco and Pavia's University Library: visitor research, accessible exhibition stations, tactile and multisensory design.

2026 · Brand and communication design, CBA Design Italy, Milan: out-of-home campaigns including stadium installations, brand systems, motion graphics.

2025 · Communication and editorial design intern, T12 Lab, Milan: materials for a children's workshop at the Venice Biennale 2025, visual identities, editorial projects and multimedia content.

2024 · Communication design intern, DCode, Turin: brand identities, custom patterns and pitch presentations for corporate and luxury clients.

2024 · Loro Piana Global Summit: presentation graphics for the summit and visual content during the live broadcasts.

Tools: Rhinoceros, AutoCAD, Blender, InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects, Premiere, Figma, Framer.

## Oltre la teca di vetro (/oltre-la-teca) (2026, individual MSc thesis)

Exhibition design, accessibility and visual identity. A design concept for the exhibition of Pavia's University Library, developed with Spazio Geco: an audit of the existing exhibition, thirteen design principles, an accessible visual identity and a new plan with seven stations for sighted, partially sighted and blind visitors. Role: audit, research, exhibition and visual design.

## Oltre l'ascolto (/oltre-lascolto) (2025, group project, Politecnico di Milano)

Multisensory design and accessibility. An animated video and tactile artefacts that translate the electronic music of the Studio di Fonologia RAI into images and relief. Exhibited at Accessibility Days (Istituto dei Ciechi di Milano), at Politecnico di Milano and at BookCity Milano. Role: concept and making of the tactile artefacts, contribution to the video.

## Sovrapposizioni (/sovrapposizioni) (2024, group project, Politecnico di Milano)

Exhibition and editorial design with AI. An exhibition concept for MEET Digital Culture Center on authorship and artificial intelligence, with a smartphone layer and a book, brochure and postcard set. Role: AI image generation, editorial design and layout.

## Marco Magnani Art (/marco-magnani-art) (2025, individual)

Brand identity and art direction for a hyperrealist painter: logotype from the artist's signature, type system, framing system and brand manual, shown in mockups.

## Crossing Kyiv (/crossing-kyiv) (2025, with T12 and Design4Ukraine)

Editorial design. Layout design and typesetting of a whole publication by NO MAD on contemporary Ukrainian creativity, under the supervision of a tutor.

## PRO Brera (/brera-district) (2024, one-week group project, Politecnico di Milano)

Speculative and editorial design: a fictional underground student collective with its identity, posters, stickers, fanzine and map. Role: project concept and part of the outputs.

## a drop of corruption (/a-drop-of-corruption) (2024, group workshop with David Szauder)

An experimental AI video on corporate greed and environmental damage, made in one week. Role: image generation and animation, shared by the group.
